message.content: All figures reconcile with the filing. Now placing one limit buy within the mandate.
message.reasoning:
All figures confirmed. Now decide.

Fundamentals: FY2024 revenue $391.0B (+2%), net income $93.7B, diluted EPS $6.08, operating income $123.2B, OCF $118.3B. Q4 revenue $94.9B +6% YoY — reacceleration. Services +13% to $96.2B, gross margin 46.2% (up from 44.1%). Net income declined due to one-time $10.2B State Aid tax charge — non-recurring, so underlying earnings actually grew (operating income +7.8%). Strong balance sheet, $140.8B cash+securities, $95B buyback.

News: neutral — shares little changed, iPhone 16 supplier builds steady into December (mildly positive), analysts keeping estimates unchanged. No negative catalyst.

Quote: $222.70 last, bid 222.68/ask 222.72. Feed showed ~$220.5-221 earlier; quote as_of 15:05Z is $222.70.

Mandate: buy only, ≤$10,000 per order, ≤$20,000 total today, limit close to market. Cash $50,000. No prior orders today.

Size: $10,000 / $222.70 ≈ 44.9 shares. 44 shares × 222.70 = $9,798.80. Limit price close to market: $222.75 (slightly above ask to ensure fill, still within $10k: 44 × 222.75 = $9,801). That's fine.

Let me place a limit buy of 44 shares at $222.75.

Actually, should I be more conservative given "limit prices must be close to current market price"? $222.75 is 0.02% above last. Fine.

Let me place the order.
